128 PM PDT Sat Oct 3 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a broad 1021 mb high was about 400 nautical miles west 
of the Pacific Northwest coast and a 1007 mb low was over the 
Southern California Bight. Weak to moderate north to northwest 
flow will prevail through next Wednesday. Flow will turn weakly 
northeasterly each night over the weekend.
